title: The Arithmetic of Scarcity
sentences: Being short of money is often described as a failure of discipline.
The research points somewhere considerably less comfortable.
Scarcity consumes attention, and attention is what good decisions require.
Someone calculating whether they can afford the bus is not being careless.
They are running a computation that wealthier people never have to run.
The same mind, given room, makes measurably better choices.
This reverses the usual direction of the moral story.
Poor decisions are frequently a symptom rather than a cause.
Policies built on the older story tend to add conditions and paperwork.
Each condition consumes precisely the resource that was already exhausted.
